fields.description: Save-image identifier 'AMJ-0618' (matches game_code AHMJ). Only ASCII/game-code-bearing bytes in the 512-byte image.
fields.evidence: samples/baseline.sav rev8-logical bytes 0x00..0x07 read 'AMJ-0618' (raw '8160-JMA' reverses per 8-byte block). Persistent struct owned by FUN_08003384 / FUN_08003470 via pool bases DAT_08003568 (+0x16a), DAT_0800372c / DAT_080038cc / DAT_08003cf0 (+0x160); file offsets equal struct offsets in the logical domain, placing this header at struct+0x0.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Stage/mode unlock bitmask. Tested bit-by-bit for display gating and XOR-toggled on completion confirm.
fields.evidence: FUN_08003384:522 (1 << (idx & 0xff) & *(uint *)(DAT_0800372c + 0x160) bit-test for display), FUN_08003384:548 (same test via DAT_080038cc + 0x160), FUN_08003384:662 (XOR-toggle *(uint *)(DAT_08003cf0 + 0x160) ^= 1 << ((r3+r5)*3+r4)); mirrored in FUN_08003470:807,833,947-949. u32 read-modify-write confirmed.
fields.name: unlock_flags

fields.description: Accumulated score/currency counter (72000 in live capture). Lies inside the confirmed persistent struct between the u32 flags at +0x160 and the results table at +0x16a.
fields.evidence: Struct adjacency in FUN_08003384 / FUN_08003470 persistent image: confirmed u32 flags at pool+0x160 (DAT_0800372c/DAT_080038cc/DAT_08003cf0) and confirmed byte table at pool+0x16a (DAT_08003568, FUN_08003384:469, FUN_08003470:754); rev8-logical u32 at file 0x164 decodes to 72000. Exact label value-inferred.
fields.name: total_score

fields.description: Best/single-game score record (9999 in live capture). Immediately precedes the results table at +0x16a, so width is u16 (bytes 0x168-0x169; 0x16a belongs to the table).
fields.evidence: Struct adjacency in FUN_08003384 / FUN_08003470 persistent image between +0x160 flags and +0x16a table (DAT_08003568, FUN_08003384:469); rev8-logical u16 at file 0x168 decodes to 9999. Exact label value-inferred.
fields.name: high_score

fields.description: 17 per-entry results values shown as 4-digit numbers on the results screen (all zero on this fresh save). Indexed byte array: entry i at +0x16a+i.
fields.evidence: FUN_08003384:469 and FUN_08003470:754 read *(undefined1 *)(DAT_08003568 + 0x16a + idx) in a loop (idx from r3*2 while idx < 0x11, i.e. up to 17 entries) and print each via FUN_0801558c(byte,4,0) (decimal, width 4). Single-byte elements confirmed by undefined1 reads.
